_about: Reference library of waste collection vehicle classes for the Route Builder. Every figure carries a source. 'sourced': false marks a figure that could not be sourced and is an editable planning assumption. Values are editable in the UI; edits are saved separately and never overwrite this file.

standards_note.summary: BIS standards exist but are dated (1986-1989) and give only broad ranges. None covers electric or CNG three-wheelers, compartmentalised bodies or minimum road width. IS 12662 (Part 1):1989 'Guidelines for use of vehicles for collection of municipal solid wastes' gives payload 1 to 1.5 tonnes for short range small capacity vehicles, pedal tricycle containers of 0.2 to 0.25 m3, and notes compaction from 125-150 kg/m3 to about 500 kg/m3. IS 11625:1986 (guide for collection and transportation of solid wastes) and IS 12647:1989 (collection equipment) also exist. No current BIS standard for refuse collection vehicle capacity was found.

stream_densities_kg_m3._note: Loose (uncompacted) bulk density per stream, used to convert kg to body volume. Assumptions, editable.

wet.note: Assumed. CPHEEO gives 450-500 kg/m3 for Indian MSW overall (Part I, section 1.4.2.3.3); wet waste is taken at the upper end.

dry.note: Low density material such as paper and plastics: 125-150 kg/m3 before compaction.

compacted_max.note: Rear loading compactors compress waste to 800-900 kg/m3 (Part II, section 2.3.11.3).

body_volume_m3.note: Closed hopper in two partitions of 0.6 m3 each (dry and wet) on Euler HiLoad EV.

payload_kg.note: Treo Zor 550 kg, Piaggio Ape E-Xtra FX 506 kg, Euler HiLoad 688 kg (aggregator figures). The garbage body builder lists 550 kg on the HiLoad.

compaction_ratio.note: No compaction; CPHEEO notes compactors are not used for primary collection (Table 2.3).

compartments.note: Wet and dry partitions. Also required by SWM Rules 2026 r. 8(h)(iv).

vehicle_width_m.note: Unsourced for the EV models; comparable CNG three-wheeler is 1.493 m (Bajaj).

min_road_width_m.note: Unsourced planning assumption: vehicle width plus about 1 m for manoeuvring and passing.

service.note: Unsourced planning assumption. Per-building service time = base + kg collected / kg_per_min, clamped to 1-5 minutes.

crew.note: Unsourced planning assumption: one driver plus the collectors who load at each stop. A vehicle record can set its own crew.

body_volume_m3.note: Unsourced. Assumed same garbage body as the e-loader. The flat cargo deck is 1.65 x 1.425 m with 0.275 m sides (aggregator).

payload_kg.note: DECIDED 430 kg. Manufacturer page gives GVW 986 kg and kerb 556 kg for the CNG Maxima C, implying about 430 kg; an aggregator lists 619 kg (GVW 1250 kg). The manufacturer figure is used because it is the primary source and a steel garbage body adds weight that the bare chassis payload does not include. Editable if a fleet operator's registered payload is available.
